SETTINGS_TITLE.description: UI: Main section heading. Context: Appears at the very top of the plugin's settings tab.

SETTINGS_DESCRIPTION.description: UI: Subtitle text. Context: Appears directly below the main settings heading.

BUTTON_ADD_ACTION.description: UI: Button label. Context: Used to create a new custom action in the settings list.

NEW_ACTION_DEFAULT_NAME.description: UI: Default text input value. Context: The placeholder name assigned when a new action is first created.

RULE_COUNT_SINGLE.description: UI: Text badge in a list. Context: Shows a singular count of find/replace rules inside an action. {0} is the number (1).

RULE_COUNT_PLURAL.description: UI: Text badge in a list. Context: Shows a plural count of find/replace rules inside an action. {0} is the number (>1).

ACTION_CONFIGURATION_TITLE.description: UI: Section heading. Context: Appears inside the modal window where users edit a specific action.

ACTION_SUMMARY.description: UI: List item description text. Context: Displays metadata below an action name. {0} is the rule count string, {1} is the context menu visibility string.

ACTION_NAME_LABEL.description: UI: Input field label. Context: Label for the text box where users name their action.

ACTION_NAME_PLACEHOLDER.description: UI: Input field placeholder. Context: Example text shown inside an empty action name input box.

ACTION_CONTEXT_MENU_TOOLTIP.description: UI: Toggle switch label. Context: Allows users to pin this specific action to their native Obsidian right-click menu.

BUTTON_ADD_RULE.description: UI: Button label. Context: Adds a new blank find-and-replace row to the action's sequence.

CONFIRM_DELETE_ACTION_TITLE.description: UI: Modal dialog title. Context: Asks for confirmation before deleting an entire action.

CONFIRM_DELETE_ACTION_DESC.description: UI: Modal dialog body text. Context: Warns the user about permanent deletion of an action.

CONFIRM_DELETE_RULE_TITLE.description: UI: Modal dialog title. Context: Asks for confirmation before deleting a single find-and-replace rule.

CONFIRM_DELETE_RULE_DESC.description: UI: Modal dialog body text. Context: Warns the user about permanent deletion of a rule.

BUTTON_DELETE.description: UI: Destructive button label. Context: Confirms the deletion of an item.

BUTTON_CANCEL.description: UI: Button label. Context: Closes a dialog without making changes.

CONTEXT_MENU_VISIBLE.description: UI: Status text. Context: Appears in the settings list to indicate this action is pinned to the right-click menu.

CONTEXT_MENU_HIDDEN.description: UI: Status text. Context: Appears in the settings list to indicate this action is NOT pinned to the right-click menu.

TEST_BENCH_TITLE.description: UI: Section heading. Context: Appears above the sequence of find/replace inputs in the editor modal.

TEST_BENCH_LABEL.description: UI: Toggle switch label. Context: Controls whether the live preview input/output text areas are visible.

TEST_BENCH_DESC.description: UI: Description text. Context: Explains the purpose of the test bench toggle switch.

TEST_INPUT_LABEL.description: UI: Label for a text area. Context: Marks the box where users can paste sample text to test their rules against.

TEST_INPUT_PLACEHOLDER.description: UI: Placeholder text. Context: Shown when the test input text area is empty.

ERROR_NAME_EMPTY.description: UI: Error message. Context: Appears beneath the name input if the user deletes all text.

ERROR_NAME_DUPLICATE.description: UI: Error message. Context: Appears beneath the name input if the user enters a name used by another action.

ERROR_PREVIOUS_STEP_FAILED.description: UI: Error message. Context: Appears in an output box if a preceding rule in the sequence crashed.

ERROR_INVALID_REGEX.description: UI: Error message. Context: Appears when a user writes a broken regular expression.

RULE_SEARCH_LABEL.description: UI: Input field label. Context: The target word or regex pattern the user wants to find.

RULE_SEARCH_PLACEHOLDER.description: UI: Input field placeholder. Context: Shown in the empty search input box.

RULE_REPLACE_LABEL.description: UI: Input field label. Context: The text the user wants to replace the search term with.

RULE_REPLACE_PLACEHOLDER.description: UI: Input field placeholder. Context: Shown in the empty replace input box.

RULE_REGEX_LABEL.description: UI: Toggle switch label. Context: Turns on Regular Expression parsing for a specific rule.

RULE_FLAGS_LABEL.description: UI: Input field label. Context: Regular Expression modifiers (like 'g' or 'i').

RULE_FLAGS_INFO.description: UI: Tooltip text prefix. Context: Shown when a user enters invalid regex flags, preceding the list of allowed characters.

BUTTON_MOVE_RULE_UP.description: UI: Icon button tooltip. Context: Shifts a find/replace rule earlier in the execution sequence.

BUTTON_MOVE_RULE_DOWN.description: UI: Icon button tooltip. Context: Shifts a find/replace rule later in the execution sequence.

BUTTON_REMOVE_RULE.description: UI: Icon button tooltip. Context: Triggers the deletion of a specific rule row.

FINAL_OUTPUT_LABEL.description: UI: Text area label. Context: Marks the box showing the fully processed text at the end of the rule sequence.

STEP_OUTPUT_LABEL.description: UI: Text area label. Context: Marks the box showing intermediate processed text in the middle of a rule sequence.

CONTEXT_MENU_TITLE.description: UI: Context menu item label. Context: The main folder name inside Obsidian's right-click menu.

NOTICE__APPLIED_CHANGES_SINGLE.description: UI: Toast notification. Context: Confirms successful execution for exactly 1 change. {0} is the action name, {1} is the number of changes (always 1).

NOTICE__APPLIED_CHANGES_PLURAL.description: UI: Toast notification. Context: Confirms successful execution for multiple (or zero) changes. {0} is the action name, {1} is the number of changes.

NOTICE__ERROR.description: UI: Toast notification. Context: Displays a caught error to the user. {0} is the technical error message.

ERROR_NO_MARKDOWN_FILES.description: UI: Toast notification. Context: Warns the user when they try to run a bulk replace on incompatible files (like images or PDFs).

BULK_REPLACE_WARNING_TITLE.description: UI: Modal dialog title. Context: Warns the user before running a destructive operation on multiple files.

BULK_REPLACE_WARNING_DESC_SINGLE.description: UI: Modal dialog body text. Context: Singular warning message. {0} is the file count (always 1), {1} is the action name.

BULK_REPLACE_WARNING_DESC_PLURAL.description: UI: Modal dialog body text. Context: Plural warning message. {0} is the file count (>1), {1} is the action name.

BUTTON_REPLACE_ALL.description: UI: Destructive button label. Context: Confirms the bulk replacement operation.

NOTICE__PROCESSING_FILES_SINGLE.description: UI: Toast notification. Context: Singular loading state message while a bulk operation runs. {0} is the file count (always 1).

NOTICE__PROCESSING_FILES_PLURAL.description: UI: Toast notification. Context: Plural loading state message while a bulk operation runs. {0} is the file count (>1).

NOTICE__BULK_REPLACE_COMPLETE.description: UI: Toast notification. Context: Grammar-neutral success message after a bulk operation. {0} is the total number of text replacements, {1} is the number of files modified.

CONTEXT_MENU_BULK_TITLE.description: UI: Context menu item label. Context: The main folder name inside the File Explorer's right-click menu.

CONTEXT_MENU_ALL_COMMANDS.description: UI: Context menu item label. Context: A shortcut at the bottom of the right-click submenu to open the main search modal.
